text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v1.4.2 in ~6h. Need quick confirmations: version bump PR, changelog, security signoff, docs handoff, and a brief canary plan. Can owners shout?

dave: Version bump PR (#4512) is merged and green. commit 4f2a1b3. Left a note in the PR about the telemetry tweak. :white_check_mark:

lee: Docs docsite changes are staged on branch docs/v1.4.2. Will merge after cutoff to avoid CI churn. I've updated the release notes section (docs/release-1-4-2.md).

oliver: Running quick SCA and dependency scan now. If nothing else pops up I'll add an approval comment on the PRs. ETA ~30m.

sasha: I can own the smoke suite and the canary. Need the canary list (routes + sample payloads). Also, which staging cluster are we targeting?

maria: @sasha target staging-us-west for the canary. Canary list: /generate, /chat-stream, /embed. Sample payloads in the release PR description.

dave: I'll coordinate branch syncs and cherry-picks. Plan: create release/v1.4.2 from main, cherry-pick hotfixes A and B, push, then tag. Commands I'll run:
```
# create release branch
git checkout main && git pull origin main
git checkout -b release/v1.4.2
git cherry-pick 9c7a2d1 2b8f3c4
git push origin release/v1.4.2
```

maria: That flow sounds good. Please hold the tag until security signoff is in.

oliver: Confirmed — will not approve tag until SCA results are posted. If anything major shows up I'll ping here.

sasha: Smoke tests ready to run once you push the branch. I have an automated checklist: preflight, canary-1 (staging-us-west), canary-2 (staging-eu), rollout-if-green.

release-bot: CI: build 3789 passed for release/v1.4.2 (duration: 8m).

maria: Quick doc ask @lee — can you add the short 'rollback' note to the release page (one-liner) so support has the steps?

lee: Yep adding now. Will push within 10m.

deploy-bot: Security scan: dependency vulnerabilities found: 0 critical, 1 high (transitive). Details posted to PR #4512.

oliver: Saw the high — it's transitive in test-utils, not shipped. Marking as acceptable for this patch but I'll log it in the backlog. Adding signoff comment.

dave: Branch pushed: origin/release/v1.4.2. Ready for tagging when we get final thumbs.

sasha: Running smoke suite on staging-us-west now. Kicking off canary-1.

maria: If QA passes and security signoff is present, I'll cut the tag and coordinate the canary rollout.

sasha: Canary-1 passed (latency within SLOs). Canary-2 queued.

release-bot: Canary-2 (staging-eu) passed. No regression alerts.

oliver: Security signoff posted on PR. No blocking issues.

maria: All checks green — cutting v1.4.2 tag now. Dave, please push the tag and then I'll open the announce draft.

dave: Tag pushed and release notes published. `git tag -a v1.4.2 -m \"v1.4.2\" && git push origin v1.4.2`

maria: :tada: Release cut complete. I've posted the announce draft to #announcements for review. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

lee: Docs merged and small rollback note added.

sasha: Rollout monitoring looks clean so far. I will keep an eye for 1h and post summary.

maria: Closing checklist — leaving this thread for the post-release log. If anything critical appears, ping here. :thumbsup:
